snippet.title: Resident Evil 3 : The Only One [ Playstation Mod ]
snippet.description:
So this is it! After working 6 hours for day during one month, here it is :

Resident Evil 3 - The only one

I wanted to say, that this mod it's not my best creation, since if i have more time, i could do more awesome and acurate stuff. The changes are the next ones :

CHANGES :

Reloading tool has 30 uses
Randomized enemies
Randomized items 
Some rooms have a timer
Start in a different room
Small changes to the first intro
New HUD and changed font of the inventory menu
New costume
New routes
New documents
New combinations
New weapon features
Reduced the limit to carry on shells , bullets and greanades
New way to arribe to the clocktower
More enemies
No enhaced ammo
Different locations
Damage for some weapons has been reduced and increased
Less item box and ink ribbons
Faster zombies in some locations
Faster nemesis in some locations
You don't wear the backpack ( wich means you have less space in your inventory )
Exclusive room modifications on the SCD section never seen before on PSX


MERCENARIES EXTREME BATTLE :
a small face wash to this mode, where all the mercs have different weapons and added some harder enemies at the beggining


BRAND NEW SYSTEM OF REWARDS :
Once you finish the game for first time you will unlock the SECRET WEAPON SECTION.
And everytime you unlock a new epilogue you will reciebe the combination to create
one of the 3 exclusive weapons

AND MANNY MORE !

Thanks everyone for watching ! 

Extra credits : 
El rincon del Lobezno for the skin of Jill survivor Nº2
Komizo_Lab for the nemesis animations and me ( biohazard españa )
for adapt it to work on the PSX.
